correctness.rationale: For the reversed left brace the lambda action is \(\lambda_g(f)=f(x+g)\) modulo \(x^{N+1}\). If the least nonzero term of \(g\) has degree \(e<N\), testing \(f=x^2\) gives leading change \(2b_ex^{e+1}\), nonzero when the characteristic is not two; every multiple of \(x^N\) acts trivially. Hence the socle is exactly \(Kx^N\). Reduction modulo \(x^N\) is a brace quotient isomorphic to the next truncation, so induction removes one highest-degree coefficient at each step and gives level \(N-1\). For odd prime fields, every strict factor in a finite socle series has additive order at least \(p\), proving the order-based upper bound. An independent direct substitution enumeration reproduced the predicted socle for \((p,N)=(3,2),(3,3),(5,4)\).
